features: Fixed a crash that occurred when typing the Beneficiary IBAN on the supplier payment edit page.

The "bonifico parlante" (the qualifying bank transfer required for Italian tax deductions), the deduction type and bank fees are now correctly saved when editing an already registered supplier payment.
Reversed supplier payments can no longer be reached from the edit page: a clear message is now shown instead of a save that silently had no effect.
Added an account balance check when editing a supplier payment too, with an explicit confirmation required in case of overdraft — as was already the case when creating a payment.
Added a safeguard that prevents editing cumulative payments spanning multiple invoices, to avoid corrupting the allocated amounts.

The "bonifico parlante" field, reserved for tax deductions (renovations, eco-bonus, seismic bonus, superbonus), now only appears for payments made by bank transfer: Italian law does not allow cash or checks for these deductions.
Improved the layout of the supplier payment edit page: full-width card, related fields placed side by side, and a more compact save button, consistent with the other pages of the management module.
Fixed some display issues on the supplier payment edit page on smartphones, where some fields could overlap.
